function asserted<K extends number>(index: K, items: (string | undefined)[]): string {
  const item: string = items[index]!;
  return item;
}

function compared<K extends number>(index: K, items: (string | undefined)[]): string {
  const item = items[index];
  if (item !== undefined) {
    const text: string = item;
    return text;
  }
  return "-";
}

function truthy<K extends number>(index: K, items: (string | undefined)[]): number {
  const item = items[index];
  if (item) return item.length;
  return 0;
}

function filled<K extends number>(index: K, items: (string | undefined)[]): string {
  const item: string = (items[index] ??= "filled");
  return item;
}

function defaulted<K extends number>(index: K, items: (string | undefined)[]): string {
  const item: string = items[index] ?? "default";
  return item;
}

function parameterCompared<T extends string | undefined>(value: T): string {
  if (value !== undefined) {
    const text: string = value;
    return text;
  }
  return "-";
}

function parameterAsserted<T extends string | undefined>(value: T): number {
  return value!.length;
}

function keepsIdentity<T extends string | undefined>(value: T): T {
  if (value !== undefined) return value;
  return value;
}

const items = ["a", undefined, "ccc"];
console.log(asserted(0, items), compared(0, items), compared(1, items));
console.log(truthy(2, items), truthy(1, items), defaulted(1, items));
console.log(filled(1, items), items);
console.log(parameterCompared("p"), parameterCompared(undefined), parameterAsserted("four"), keepsIdentity("k"));
